speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal — your first run
description: First-run walkthrough (~73s, v7 after the 2026-08-12 review rounds): clean start (no preset chips), typed path with a launch-button ring, fast-forward-and-pause PR montage, same-repo chip relaunch showing the Claude startup screen, worktree form zoomed then pulled out to two cells, third project, end card. Footage: mt-demo-home/footage/2026-08-12/first-run-t9/ (cut recipes in its cut*.sh / concat*.sh).

beats.text: One command — and your terminal opens in the browser.

html: MulmoTerminal — first run
Your first run.

<div class='absolute rounded-xl bg-slate-900 shadow-2xl border border-slate-800' style='top:300px;left:240px;width:800px;height:150px' data-animation='animate' data-opacity='0,1' data-start='0.2' data-end='0.8' data-easing='easeOut'>
$ npx mulmoterminal@latest
Node 22.9+ · MIT · runs locally

beats.text: Pick your agent — Claude, Codex, whichever you run. Type the path to any folder on your machine, and launch.

html: MulmoTerminal — first run
Pick an agent. Pick a folder.
<video src='./first-run-assets/01-launch.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:880px;display:block'></video>

beats.text: Then you just type what you want — plain words, like you'd tell a teammate what to build.

html: MulmoTerminal — first run
Just ask.
<video src='./first-run-assets/02-ask.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:880px;display:block'></video>

beats.text: It writes the code and runs the tests. Commit. Push. Pull request. Merged. The ring turns green — done, ready for review.

html: MulmoTerminal — first run
Commit. Push. PR. Merged.
<video src='./first-run-assets/03-merged.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:880px;display:block'></video>

beats.text: Come back later — your folder is a chip now. One click, and you're back in.

html: MulmoTerminal — first run
Round two is one click.
<video src='./first-run-assets/04-second.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:880px;display:block'></video>

beats.text: Need a second agent on the same repo? Name the task — it gets its own worktree, and its own cell.

html: MulmoTerminal — first run
Same repo? New worktree.
<video src='./first-run-assets/05-worktree.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:880px;display:block'></video>

beats.text: And there it is — two agents, one repo, side by side.

html: MulmoTerminal — first run
Now there are two.
<video src='./first-run-assets/06-two.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:880px;display:block'></video>

beats.text: Add the next project the same way. This is how the grid grows.

html: MulmoTerminal — first run
The grid grows with you.
<video src='./first-run-assets/07-grid.mp4' autoplay muted playsinline class='rounded-xl shadow-2xl' style='width:880px;display:block'></video>
